Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent misidentified the “current C-suite” by relying on incomplete/irrelevant search snippets and conflating board members and other roles (e.g., Jeff Horing, Gili Iohan, Avishai Abrahami) with C-suite executives. This early misclassification (without verifying against authoritative sources like monday.com’s management page) led to an incorrect comparison set and propagated to the final answer, where non–C-suite individuals (e.g., HR Manager, General Counsel) were treated as C-suite and wrongly concluded as not being in C-suite at IPO.
